reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "fix(gcp): makes workload identity parameters optional by @gusfcarvalho in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4622", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The GCP workload identity parameters are no longer required, so a provider configuration that omits them is accepted where it previously was not; the evidence describes no failure or removal of behaviour.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is described; review GCP provider configurations only if strict validation of the workload identity parameters was relied upon.

proposed.statement: In external-secrets 0.16.0 the GCP workload identity parameters become optional (i.e. they were previously mandatory to set), a change the release notes list under breaking changes.
